env.name: Environment variables
env.warning: Sets user environment variables (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY); the previous values come back when it is turned off.

git.name: Git
git.warning: While on, changes the global Git proxy (http.proxy, https.proxy); the previous proxy comes back when it is turned off.

gradle.name: Gradle
gradle.warning: While on, adds a proxy block to the user's gradle.properties; turning it off removes only that block.

studio.name: Android Studio
studio.warning: While on, sets the proxy of the newest installed Android Studio; the previous options come back when it is turned off.
